description: Texts spoken in DECtalk's europe mode, which reads a comma in a number as the decimal mark and a period as the mark between thousands, and a date with the day first: numbers written the mode's way and the other way, with a sign and a percent sign; money; dates in digits with slashes and hyphens, a date token and a date in words; a clock time, a telephone number and a text with no number, which the mode leaves alone; the mode turned off again, set, turned on and off inside a text, and on together with the math mode. Written before any export and not edited afterwards.
